findings.observation: Guard asks credential.LacksRightsFor(connection.NeededWorkItemRights), so it depends on the connection's mappings being loaded; with zero mappings a read-only credential is not stopped (pinned by A_read_only_sign_in_does_not_block_a_write_while_the_connection_has_no_write_back_mapping). Quote: return credential?.LacksRightsFor(connection.NeededWorkItemRights) ?? false; Real callers load mappings via Team/Portfolio repositories, so non-blocking
findings.remediation: Guard on !credential.HasWriteConsent (a write is always a write) and drop or revise that oracle row
